nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.description: Satisfaction may exist inside one bounded Session, while pull may exist only between Sessions.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.description: One complete nightly arc whose required effort decreases until it ends itself.

nodes.label: Wall
nodes.description: A user-chosen nightly boundary that redirects selected unbounded apps while preserving an unguilted way through.

nodes.label: Dismissal
nodes.description: The single Not now choice that removes the Wall for the rest of the night without guilt, penalty, or repeated prompting.

nodes.label: Night ID
nodes.description: Immutable Dawn date, captured IANA time zone, and recipe version selecting one deterministic night.

nodes.label: Dawn
nodes.description: The before-noon return to the previous Session's Vista and the product's only reward-bearing surface.

nodes.label: Echo
nodes.description: A quiet non-numeric trace of a previously settled Visitor, unaffected by skipped nights.

nodes.label: Required Action
nodes.description: A non-failing one-finger action needed to advance the Session, with a semantic non-Canvas equivalent.

nodes.label: Handoff
nodes.description: The moment when Drift stops requiring touch and commits the Session to its ending.

nodes.label: Independent browser artifact pair
nodes.description: An installable offline PWA at /play/ and a self-contained service-worker-free nindova.html built from the same Session source.

nodes.label: Focal sprite sheet
nodes.description: AI-generated gouache-style sheet of twelve focal objects and Visitors with procedural runtime fallbacks.

nodes.label: Semantic action dock
nodes.description: Native buttons, form controls, focus treatment, and live status used as non-Canvas completion paths.

nodes.label: Quiet end card
nodes.description: Terminal surface stating that the Session is over, omitting score and streak language and offering only a local tomorrow intention in production.

nodes.label: Dawn surface
nodes.description: Morning overlay rendering last night's Vista with explicit still, share, loop, and close actions.

nodes.label: PWA service-worker bootstrap
nodes.description: HTTP-only registration of the play-scoped service worker, removed from the portable composition.

nodes.label: Accessible completion contract
nodes.description: Every required act has keyboard-operable semantic controls, visible focus, status output, 44-pixel targets, and reduced-motion behavior.

nodes.label: Session module boundaries
nodes.description: Core owns order and closure; Stage owns rendering; Interaction owns semantic and pointer input; Night owns deterministic state; Dawn owns morning rendering and export.

nodes.label: Shared-source artifact composition
nodes.description: One compiled TypeScript graph feeds the multi-file PWA and standalone HTML, while the site and docs compose into the same static root artifact.

nodes.label: Dawn eligibility window
nodes.description: Dawn is eligible only from 06:00 through 11:59 on the captured Dawn date evaluated in the Session's captured time zone.

nodes.label: Dawn export lifecycle
nodes.description: Local PNG and capability-appropriate silent-loop exports fail independently, preserve Dawn usability, and revoke temporary URLs.

nodes.label: Frozen Wall agency contract
nodes.description: The person explicitly chooses apps and time, while one calm Not now dismissal preserves voluntary same-night entry.

nodes.label: Native Wall proof boundary
nodes.description: Family Controls entitlement, managed settings, distribution, and real OS behavior require a separate native implementation and evidence track.

nodes.label: Deterministic local night state
nodes.description: Captured night identity selects a versioned recipe while a single bounded local record stores only Dawn and quiet-scene continuity facts.

nodes.label: Same-night replay idempotence
nodes.description: Replaying the same night cannot duplicate Echoes, boats, completion, or return intention.

nodes.label: Fixed nightly act sequence
nodes.description: Intake, Arrive, Put away, Settle, Approach, Vista, Drift and Return, and Close form the one invariant route.

nodes.label: Closure convergence
nodes.description: No-input, partial-input, held-pointer, cancelled-pointer, lost-focus, and optional-naming paths all end within the hidden fifteen-minute cap.

nodes.label: Zero-telemetry runtime boundary
nodes.description: The Session uses same-origin static requests only and has no account, analytics, advertising, remote logging, social SDK, or third-party runtime dependency.

nodes.label: Offline cache boundary
nodes.description: The /play/ worker caches only its versioned static shell and never local storage, generated blobs, share payloads, or unrelated caches.

nodes.label: Immutable product language
nodes.description: The intake, ending, behavioral-study, age, non-treatment, and CBT-I boundary language that production surfaces must preserve.

nodes.label: Punjabi and Indian visual-world ethics
nodes.description: Material craft and night-landscape cues must remain specific, respectful, contemporary, non-religious by default, and separate from localization.

nodes.label: Evidence levels
nodes.description: Findings are classified as Verified, Source-proven, or Untested risk according to the observed proof surface.

nodes.label: Regression and surface gates
nodes.description: Asserted arc, portrait, self-closing, night, Dawn, PWA, wall-clock, type, unit, build, and rendered-inspection gates.

nodes.label: Scullin et al. 2018
nodes.description: Randomized laboratory study comparing future to-do-list writing with completed-activity writing before polysomnography.
nodes.rationale: Supports considering optional specific naming before an object is put away, without claiming Nindova reproduces the studied writing task or outcome.

nodes.label: Harvey and Payne 2002
nodes.description: Study comparing specific imagery distraction, general distraction, and no instruction among people with insomnia.
nodes.rationale: Supports one concrete procession rather than vague prompts, while the interactive Vista remains distinct from the study protocol.

nodes.label: Hill et al. 2022
nodes.description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of bedtime procrastination and evening chronotype.
nodes.rationale: Supports targeting the intention-to-stop gap with a bounded ending, not claiming a change in chronotype or sleep quality.

nodes.label: Brosnan et al. 2024
nodes.description: Repeated objective observations associating interactive in-bed screen use in youths with later sleep onset and shorter sleep time.
nodes.rationale: Supports making the screen path bounded and self-ending while acknowledging that use of another screen has costs.

nodes.label: Hartstein et al. 2022
nodes.description: Small study reporting high evening-light melatonin suppression across tested intensities in preschool-aged children.
nodes.rationale: Supports real brightness decay and an age-13-plus boundary, without claiming measured biological outcomes.

nodes.label: American College of Physicians CBT-I guideline
nodes.description: Clinical guideline recommending CBT-I as the initial treatment for adults with chronic insomnia disorder.
nodes.rationale: Establishes the product boundary that persistent sleep difficulty deserves qualified evidence-based care and Nindova does not diagnose or treat insomnia.
nodes.norm_label: american college of physicians cbt-i guideline

nodes.label: Approved delivery contract
nodes.description: Behavior-preserving seed extension, shared TypeScript and Canvas core, local-only state, zero telemetry, independent artifacts, per-slice commits, and no release authorization.

nodes.label: M0 public baseline
nodes.description: Establish repository surfaces, preserve the seed and handoff artifacts, distinguish observational evidence from assertions, and create the workspace.

nodes.label: M1 portrait accessibility
nodes.description: Make the full Session portrait-first and semantically operable across zoom, rotation, reduced motion, keyboard, and pointer edge cases.

nodes.label: M2 self-closing Session
nodes.description: Improve tactile behavior, add focal sprites, enforce monotonic assistance and luminance envelopes, and prove autonomous closure.

nodes.label: M3 deterministic nights
nodes.description: Add immutable night identity, deterministic variety, bounded quiet memory, safe recovery, and idempotent replay.

nodes.label: M4 Dawn keepsake
nodes.description: Add captured-zone morning eligibility, first-light reconstruction, and local still and silent-loop exports.

nodes.label: M5 public surfaces
nodes.description: Ship the website, documentation, installable offline PWA, standalone HTML, and quiet local return intention.

nodes.label: M6 hardening and public proof
nodes.description: Run complete source and rendered-surface gates, refresh Graphify, inspect inventory, and push verified commits without claiming deployment.

nodes.label: Hybrid Procedural Illustration
nodes.rationale: Retain responsive, asset-light procedural atmosphere while giving emotionally important focal objects and characters an authored illustrated finish.

nodes.label: Hybrid Procedural and Composed Audio
nodes.rationale: Keep continuous ambience adaptive and lightweight while composed closure accents carry the product's sonic identity.

nodes.label: User-Chosen Unguilted Wall
nodes.rationale: Preserve meaningful precommitment without preselection, repeated nagging, punitive blocking, or delegated scheduling.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Vista Memory
nodes.rationale: Use bounded, non-numeric continuity without creating a countable collection, skipped-night loss, or attendance pressure.

nodes.label: Fifteen-Minute Session Cap
nodes.rationale: At the cap, one final response hands control to autonomous return so responsiveness cannot weaken the promise that the Session ends itself.

nodes.label: Portrait-First Session
nodes.rationale: Act-specific portrait composition and semantic equivalents must precede interaction polish because uniform landscape shrinking conflicts with phone-in-bed use.

nodes.label: Browser and PWA Before iOS Wall
nodes.rationale: Family Controls entitlement and Gate-routing uncertainty must not delay or weaken a complete browser-first experience.
nodes.norm_label: browser and pwa before ios wall

nodes.label: Public Site and Session Separation
nodes.rationale: Keep documentation searchable and marketing calm without making the nightly Session depend on the public-site framework.

nodes.label: Punjabi and Indian Material World
nodes.rationale: Ground the room and Vistas in specific everyday Punjabi and Indian materials, landscapes, geometry, and familiar objects.

nodes.label: Cultural Visual Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Avoid religious, nationalistic, exotic, festival, flag, sacred-symbol, and unrelated-collage treatments.

nodes.label: Theme and Behavior Independence
nodes.rationale: English UI and cultural styling must not alter the fixed path, accessibility equivalents, decay, closure, or behavioral claims.

nodes.label: M3 Deterministic Nights and Quiet Memory Checkpoint
nodes.norm_label: m3 deterministic nights and quiet memory checkpoint

nodes.label: Idempotent Same-Night Replay
nodes.rationale: Voluntary replay preserves the same night and memory without adding history, attendance, loss, or another Echo.

nodes.label: Export Failure Resilience
nodes.rationale: The still remains usable when loop encoding, recording, or sharing is unsupported, fails, or is cancelled, and temporary URLs are revoked.

nodes.label: M5 Website Docs and Offline PWA Evidence
nodes.norm_label: m5 website docs and offline pwa evidence

nodes.label: PWA and Standalone Independence
nodes.rationale: The installable shell is scoped to play while the self-contained artifact embeds its engines and has no manifest, worker registration, or controlling service worker.

nodes.label: Notification-Free Return Intention
nodes.rationale: The local return intention is idempotent and creates neither a notification request nor a scheduled prompt.

nodes.label: Honest Release Boundary
nodes.rationale: Chromium proof remains separate from untested installed-device, real assistive-technology, native Wall, deployment, tag, and release claims.

nodes.label: Observational Evidence Limit
nodes.rationale: The preserved script logs one attempted route but suppresses a timeout and asserts neither full order nor rendered success, accessibility, portrait, offline, or cap behavior.

nodes.label: Observational Test Limitation
nodes.rationale: The supplied test is retained only as observational evidence because it suppresses its end-card timeout and logs instead of asserting.

nodes.label: Decay-Driven Assistance
nodes.rationale: Time and completion progress increase snap and auto-fit help while light, labels, patience, and required effort decay toward autonomous closure.

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Keep satisfaction and closure inside one Session while placing curiosity and ritual only between Sessions; anything that makes tonight harder to leave is a bug.

nodes.label: Bounded Self-Ending Session
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: The fixed nightly arc becomes easier, darker, and less demanding until it closes itself without scores, failure, or sleep-performance framing.

nodes.label: Morning Dawn Reward
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Put delight, sharing, and reward energy in the morning so it cannot extend the nighttime Session.

nodes.label: Behavioral Anti-Metrics
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Watch session length, sessions per night, and late-night reopens downward, and never claim clinical sleep outcomes.

nodes.label: Evidence-Led Build Protocol
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Interview before coding, plan Must/Should/Could, preserve the seed and debug contract, build in slices, and test each change against satisfaction versus added pull.
